descriptions.zh:
欢迎光临雪拉企业！

我们是在[trader_system.GetName]恒星系对外运营的商业联合企业，主营贸易——我们雪拉企业坚信，贸易是文明的基石。

如果您想进行贸易的话，请联系我们，我们会尽量满足您的一切需要。
descriptions.en:
Welcome to XuraCorp!

We are a business conglomerate operating out of the [trader_system.GetName] system, specializing in trade - the very building blocks of civilization, as we like to say here at XuraCorp.

Please, do not hesitate to contact us if you're interested in making a good deal.

descriptions.zh:
我是里甘商业交易所的代表。我们以[trader_system.GetName]的空间站为基地，负责帮助各个团体建立完善的贸易渠道以达千年。

如果您手头有多余的资源想要出售，找我们就对了，我们提供的价格保证让您满意。
descriptions.en:
I speak on behalf of the Riggan Commerce Exchange. We have facilitated trade negotiations between interested parties on our station in the [trader_system.GetName] system for more than a thousand of your years.

If you happen to possess more resources than you need, we are more than willing to take it off your hands. You will be duly compensated, of course.

descriptions.zh:
很高兴见到你们，朋友们！我代表穆塔根商人公会欢迎你们来到[trader_system.GetName]恒星系。我们公会由数百位独立的穆塔根商船舰长组成，他们勇敢地在太空中探索，寻找商机。

您可以在我们的机构中出售多余的资源。如果您有意出售，请随时联系我们。
descriptions.en:
Well met, friends! I represent the Muutagan Merchant Guild, and let me be the first to welcome you to the [trader_system.GetName] system. Our organization consists of hundreds of independent Muutagan merchant captains who brave the spaceways in search of the next good deal.

At our facilities, you will be able to trade away some of your excess resources. Please contact us if you are interested in such an arrangement.

descriptions.zh: 雪拉企业不会对任何客户抱有偏见。毕竟我们何德何能去对您的道德准则品头论足呢？
descriptions.en: We do not discriminate against prospective buyers here at XuraCorp. Who are we to judge the morals of your star nation?

descriptions.zh: 您可能需要矿物来建造战舰，或者用它们来建造孤儿院！在雪拉企业，我们绝不会过问您打算如何使用我们的商品！
descriptions.en: Perhaps you need minerals for building warships. Perhaps you need them for building orphanages! Here at XuraCorp, we make it our business not to care!

descriptions.zh: 我们绝不过问任何事情——我们只提供品质精良的物资，保证让您十分满意，时刻准备着为您的工业建设输送新鲜血液!
descriptions.en: No questions asked - just quality resources, ready to be pumped right into the arteries of your industry!

descriptions.zh: 恕不退款，十分抱歉。这是公司的政策……这超出了我们的[xuracorp_country.species.GetHandNamePlural]掌控的范围。
descriptions.en: No refunds, I'm afraid. Company policy... It's out of my [xuracorp_country.species.GetHandNamePlural].

descriptions.zh: 客官您对本公司的非品牌蒸馏装备感兴趣吗？并不？那么微粒检测器呢？
descriptions.en: Can we interest you in some off-brand distillation equipment? No? How about particulate detectors?

descriptions.zh: 欢迎联系雪拉企业，请问您需要什么服务呢？
descriptions.en: You have reached XuraCorp. How may we help you?

descriptions.zh: 千年老字号，诚信又可靠。
descriptions.en: A thousand years and we are still in business. If that doesn't speak to our credibility, I don't know what will.

descriptions.zh: 千年之前，穆塔根帝国从浩瀚星系之中汲取惊人财富，然而现在我们这个小小的财阀成了帝国的唯一遗产。
descriptions.en: Thousands of years ago, the Muutagan Empire spanned a good portion of the galaxy. We are all that remain.

descriptions.zh: 有传言穆塔根人可以敏锐地嗅到十二个秒差距以外的商机，这种说法实在是有些夸张了……说真的，最远只有八个秒差距而已。
descriptions.en: It is said that a Muutagan can smell a good deal from a distance of twelve parsecs. This is an exaggeration... In truth, the distance is only eight parsecs.

descriptions.zh: 穆塔根商人公会欢迎您，打算来一发交易吗？
descriptions.en: The Muutagan Merchant Guild welcomes you. Would you like to make a deal?

descriptions.zh: 一个穆塔根人和一个雷西达伦人一起走进一间酒吧……算了，当我没说，这么交流实在欠妥，请您原谅。
descriptions.en: A Muutagan and a Rixidaran walk into a bar... Never mind, this does not make for appropriate conversation. I beg your forgiveness.

descriptions.zh: 您好，[Root.GetSpeciesName]。您是来这里找我们交易的吗？
descriptions.en: Greetings, [Root.GetSpeciesName]. You are here to trade with us, yes?

descriptions.zh: "折扣"这个词对于我们的人民来说是一种亵渎。在和我们交流的时候请谨记这一点。
descriptions.en: The word "discount" is considered a profanity among my people. Please keep this in mind when engaging in conversation with us.

descriptions.zh:

这是我们雪拉企业引以为傲的产品。我们的医疗部门最近开始精炼一种性质独特的气体，可以使适应外星环境的艰难过程变得轻松不少。不过它很可能无法与外星生理机能相容！

我们愿意在十个标准年里向你出口§Y异星天然气§!，之后我们就必须重新签订协议。
descriptions.en:
This is a product that we here at XuraCorp are particularly proud of. Our Medical Division has recently begun refining a gas with unique properties that will significantly ease the often difficult process of adapting to a foreign planetary environment. It is however unlikely to be compatible with alien physiology!

We are willing to export our §YExotic Gas§! to you for a period of ten standard years, after which the contract will have to be renegotiated.

If you can meet our modest price, we are willing to export Volatile Motes to you for a period of ten standard years.

descriptions.zh:
史拉卡-杜——也被我族之外的人称为§Y稀有水晶§!——已经成了我们整个文明的象征。当这些“歌唱”水晶震动时，会散发一种独特的旋律，可对大多数智慧生物起到镇静作用。

尽管我们通常不会与外人分享史拉卡杜的神奇，但可以为你开个特例。如果你付得起，我们愿意在十个标准年里向你出口我们的水晶。
descriptions.en:
Shi'rakkat-Du - or §YRare Crystals§! as they are known to those who are not of our species - have come to symbolize our entire civilization. When these "singing" crystals vibrate, they emit a unique musical tone that has a calming effect on most sapients.

Although we typically do not share the wonders of the Shi'rakkat-Du with outsiders, we are willing to make an exception in your case. If you can afford it, we are willing to export our crystals to you for a period of ten years.

descriptions.zh:
雪拉企业就该这样做生意啊！我们的货船会马上开始发货。

§L如果您购买了这个产品，也就等同于默认雪拉企业将不对使用这个产品所产生的任何副作用负责，这包括但不限于皮肤刺激，精神病发作，眼球变色，侵略性的突变，殖民地居民自杀率增加，预知恍惚，生物圈资源耗尽，高危奇异物质产生，微型黑洞生成，谷物升降机爆炸，社会崩溃，大规模灭绝事件，意外的超新星爆炸，局部或全面的星际帝国崩溃、突发的伽玛射线暴，时间旅行悖论，真空亚稳态事件，通用熵，时空连续性的崩溃……§!
descriptions.en:
That's the XuraCorp way! Our freighters will begin making deliveries immediately.

§LBy purchasing this product, you agree that XuraCorp cannot be held responsible for any adverse effects that may result from its use, including but not limited to: skin irritation, psychotic episodes, ocular discoloration, aggressive mutation, increased colonist suicide rates, precognitive trances, biosphere depletion, dangerous strangelet production, micro black hole generation, grain elevator explosions, societal collapse, mass extinction events, unexpected supernova detonations, the complete or partial destruction of your star nation, sudden gamma-ray bursts, time travel paradoxes, vacuum metastability events, universal entropy, the collapse of the space-time continuum...§!

descriptions.zh: 你不会后悔的，除非您吃了太多香料……那样的话您会有很小的几率发生自燃，不过也只有很小的几率，我很肯定。
descriptions.en: You will not be sorry. Unless you consume too much spice, of course... Then there is a small chance that you will spontaneously combust. A very small chance, to be sure.

descriptions.zh: 很好。我们的商人将立即向你的殖民地运送水晶。愿史拉卡杜对你歌唱。
descriptions.en: Excellent. Our merchants will begin shipping the crystals to your colonies at once. May the Shi'rakkat-Du sing to you.

descriptions.en: Our fleet assets have destroyed the [From.GetName] headquarters. Efforts are well under way to recover as many valuables as possible from the shattered remnants of their starbase. We have gained a large amount of resources.

descriptions.en: Dearest customer, we regret to inform you that the trade deal we negotiated for the export of Exotic Gas to the worlds of the [Root.GetName] has run its course. We are of course more than willing to extend the deal for another ten years if you have the energy credits to spare...

label.zh: 很好。我们希望延长这笔交易。
label.en: Very well. We wish to extend the deal.

label.zh: 我们对其他的东西有兴趣……

label.zh: 我们现在用不着你们的气体了。

descriptions.en: We have reached the end of our agreement, [Root.GetSpeciesName]. We have shipped Volatile Motes to your worlds for ten years. Should we continue for another ten, or do you wish to end this arrangement?

label.zh: 让我们继续，这些微粒应当保持流通。
label.en: Let us continue. The motes must flow.

label.zh: 我们对其他的东西有兴趣……
label.en: We were interested in something else...

label.zh: 我们现在不需要你的香料了。

descriptions.en: The years just fly by, don't they, [Root.GetSpeciesName]? It has now been ten years since we arranged our trade deal for Rare Crystals. Do you wish to extend the deal for another decade?

label.zh: 是的。让我们继续这个交易。
label.en: Yes. Let us continue this deal.

label.zh: 我们对其他的东西有兴趣……
label.en: We were interested in something else...

label.zh: 我们现在不需要你们的水晶了。

descriptions.zh: 你们鲁莽的袭击将雪拉企业的财产和雇员置于危险当中，我们别无选择，只能终止我们之间的贸易协定，而且我们不会退款。
descriptions.en: Your reckless attacks have put XuraCorp property and employees at risk. We have no choice but to terminate our current trade agreement. There will be no refunds.
descriptions.condition: trigger = { has_active_xuracorp_trade = yes }

descriptions.zh: 你们鲁莽的袭击威胁到了雪拉企业的财产和雇员的安全。最好记住，良好的客户关系是双向的。
descriptions.en: Your reckless attack endangers XuraCorp property and employees alike. You would do well to remember that good customer relations go both ways.
descriptions.condition: trigger = { has_active_xuracorp_trade = no }

descriptions.zh: 很抱歉，根据公司规定，我们不能和海盗进行贸易。
descriptions.en: I'm afraid it's against company policy to do business with pirates.

descriptions.zh: 我们不能接受你们这样的客户。
descriptions.en: You are not an acceptable customer.

descriptions.zh: 我们和你们没什么好谈的。
descriptions.en: We have nothing to discuss with you.

descriptions.zh: 你们竟然对我们的太空站发动袭击，不可原谅！我们不会再给你们运送货物了，明白吗？不会再给你们运送辛香料了！我们之间的贸易协定就此作废。
descriptions.en: Your attacks against our station are intolerable! You are cut off, do you understand? You may consider our trade agreement null and void.
descriptions.condition: trigger = { has_active_riggan_trade = yes }

descriptions.zh: 这次攻击无缘无故，毫无理由！我们绝不会容忍这样的行径！请你自行挂断吧。
descriptions.en: This attack is unprovoked and uncalled for! We will not stand for it. Consider yourselves cut off.
descriptions.condition: trigger = { has_active_riggan_trade = no }

descriptions.zh: 你们的人全是强盗和恶徒，我们将和你们彻底撇清关系。
descriptions.en: You are a nation of bandits and cutthroats. We will have nothing to do with you.

descriptions.zh: 海盗鼠辈。
descriptions.en: Pirate scum.

descriptions.zh: 你们的进攻行为是不可原谅的。
descriptions.en: Your attacks are unforgivable.

descriptions.zh: 啊，海盗终于展现出本来面目了！你们别想再从我们这里得到水晶了！任何一个穆塔根人都不会再和[Root.GetName]做交易了。
descriptions.en: Ah, so the pirates shows their true colors! You can forget about our trade deals! No Muutagan will do business with the [Root.GetName] again.
descriptions.condition: trigger = { has_active_muutagan_trade = yes }

descriptions.zh: 你竟敢攻击我们？搞清楚点，你这海盗：我们最瞧不起的就是这样的野蛮行径。
descriptions.en: You dare to attack us?! Know this, pirates: we do not stand for such barbarism.
descriptions.condition: trigger = { has_active_muutagan_trade = no }

descriptions.zh: 你们这群破坏分子！我们是不会忘记你们的残酷行径的。
descriptions.en: You are terrorists! Do not think we will forget your aggression against our people.

descriptions.zh: 穆塔根人可是很记仇的，[Root.GetSpeciesName]。我们绝不会忘记你们的恶行。
descriptions.en: You will find that Muutagans have very long memories, [Root.GetSpeciesName]. We never forget a slight.

descriptions.zh: 我们再也不会信任[Root.GetName]了。
descriptions.en: We will never trust the [Root.GetName] again.

descriptions.zh: 随着我们能源储备的消耗殆尽，以能源为支付手段的贸易已无法继续进行，因此所有与商人城邦之间的与能源相关协定都已取消。
descriptions.en: With our energy reserves depleted, we can no longer maintain our trade agreements that depended on this resource. All such agreements with Trader Enclaves have been canceled.

descriptions.zh:
有客人来了！这真是令人欢欣鼓舞！欧，请原谅我的失礼。我想是该自我介绍一下了。我们是艺术家联盟。

我们的成员都全身心地将自己的生命投身于艺术、音乐、文化，以及其他任何让智慧生命体的存在有所意义的事业。如果您愿意分享我们创造的奇迹，请不要犹豫，赶紧联系我们！
descriptions.en:
A visitor! This is a joyous occasion indeed! Oh, forgive my manners. I believe introductions are in order. We are the Artisan Troupe.

Our members have dedicated their lives to the pursuit of art, music, culture and all the other things which makes existence bearable to a sapient being. Please, if you would like to share in the wonder of our creations, do not hesitate to contact us!

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh:
你好！我是艺术家联盟的首席大师，衷心祝愿你今天也是才思如泉涌。

我们能为您做什么？为您打造一个用于欣赏的艺术作品？或者您希望赞助我们城邦的充满异域之美的创作？
descriptions.en:
Greetings! I, the headmaster of the Artisan Troupe, wish you a creative day.

What can we do you for? Perhaps produce a work of art for you to enjoy? Or maybe you wish to sponsor our enclave in its creation of otherworldly beauty?

descriptions.zh: 嗯？噢，请原谅，我不小心陷入了冥想状态。有时候我的这种天赋有点……太强势了。我们还有什么能够为你做的吗？
descriptions.en: Hm? Oh, please excuse my reverie. Sometimes this muse of mine is simply... overpowering. Is there anything else we can do for you?

descriptions.zh: 你是否一度为极度的壮丽而驻足惊叹？我们如此，而你们亦然。这是何等的缘分！灵感来了，我得为这写一首歌。
descriptions.en: Have you ever stopped to wonder at the sheer majesty of it all? Here we are, and there you are. What fantastic odds! I feel a ballad coming on.

descriptions.zh: 喂？你好？啊，是你！请原谅——我正好卡在了一个特别难以推敲的诗节上面。有什么事吗？
descriptions.en: Yes? Hello? Ah, it's you! Forgive me; I was stuck chasing a particularly elusive stanza. How can I help?

label.zh: 我们想委托创作一件§Y艺术品§!。
label.en: We want to commission an §Yart piece§!.

label.zh: 我们想委托创作一件§Y艺术品§!。
label.en: We want to commission an §Yart piece§!.

label.zh: 我们想要成为你们的§Y赞助者§!。
在我们所有的星球上组织一场§Y节日盛典§!。
我们希望你们帮忙建立一所§Y艺术学院§!。
label.en: We would like your help to found an §YArt College§!.

label.zh: 我们想要投资一个§Y文化中心§!。
label.en: We want to invest in a §YMinistry of Culture§!.

label.zh: §Y告诉我更多§!有关于你们艺术家联盟的信息。

descriptions.zh: 艺术家联盟拒绝回应我们的招呼。
descriptions.en: The Artisan Troupe won't respond to our hails.

descriptions.zh: 别说翻译了，只要我们发给[From.GetName]讯息，他们立马关闭所有通讯频道，拒绝与我们交流。
descriptions.en: Translations aside, once we exchanged our information with [From.GetName] they closed down all channels and refused to speak to us.

descriptions.zh: 非常感谢你！噢，这样高尚的行为，势必将鼓舞更多的艺术作品现身这个宇宙。我们坚信你会十分满意的。
descriptions.en: Thank you so very much! Ah, such a noble act it is to help bring more art into the universe. We are confident you will be satisfied.

descriptions.zh: 因为你今日的所作所为，星辰神龛今天闪耀得更加明亮了！
descriptions.en: The stars shine that bit more brightly by your actions here today!

descriptions.zh: 我们知道你们[root.GetSpeciesAdj]存在与众不同之处。讲真，你们一族真是太可口了。
descriptions.en: We knew there was something special about you [root.GetSpeciesAdj]. Truly, you are beings of refined taste.

descriptions.zh:
尊敬的[Root.GetRulerName][Root.GetRulerTitle]：十年前[Root.GetName]承诺赞助艺术家联盟，并已如约履行。

上一期的赞助已经接近尾声，谨慎起见请允许我们再度询问：您是否愿意续订全星系最精美的艺术和工艺品？
descriptions.en:
Esteemed [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName]: a decade ago the [Root.GetName] pledged to support the Artisan Troupe, and so you have.

The time of your patronage is coming to an end, but it would be remiss of us not to ask: would you care to renew your subscription to the finest arts and crafts in the galaxy?

descriptions.zh: 这里是我们为诸位赞助者提供的最新简讯：
descriptions.en: Here follows the latest newsletter for all our patrons:

descriptions.zh:
很不幸城邦中最近没能产出什么作品。大部分的艺术家都深陷忧郁之中，皆因难以迸发出创作的灵感。这种情绪十分棘手，但也有益处。毕竟创作还是要花一定时间的。

任何为了帮助这些艺术家重燃创作之火而进行的赞助，都能大大改进我们目前的创作窘境。
descriptions.en:
Sadly nothing much has been produced in the enclave. Most of the artists have fallen into a deep melancholy from where no inspiration can be drawn. The mood is dire, but hopeful. Creation takes time, after all.

Any donations that might help the group rekindle their interest in the material plane would be of tremendous help.

descriptions.zh:
整个城邦最近几个月里甚是忙碌。我们的厅堂因为居民发明的新技术而议论纷纷，这项技术能够向使用者传播嗅觉。这个非凡的器械注定能改变一切。

为了进一步发展这个想法我们需要更多的捐助。
descriptions.en:
The enclave has been busy the last couple of months. Our halls are abuzz with a new kind of technology invented by a resident, capable of transmitting sensations of smell to a user. This remarkable piece of machinery will surely change everything.

In order to further develop this idea we will require more donations.

descriptions.zh:
协会最近一直处于欢脱的氛围之中。嗅媒感知设备的发明使得一个又一个艺术家将其重心转移到为其创造全新体验上。到目前为止，他们的工作所取得的最佳成果是一首通过嗅觉信号传递的管弦乐曲。

我们的工作还在继续，同时十分乐意接受任何形式的捐助。
descriptions.en:
The enclave is in a frisky mood. The creation of the Scentilus Rift has caused many an artist to shift their primary focus to creating new experiences for it. So far the most noteworthy to come out of this endeavor is an orchestral piece conveyed via scent.

Our work continues and any donations would be gladly accepted.

descriptions.zh:
我们已经放弃继续创建以气味为中心的媒介了。这是个拙劣的想法，除了浪费时间并让室内布满臭气之外，没有任何意义。

为了能重新回到正确的创作之路，我们需要你们的赞助，我们感谢你们的继续支持！
descriptions.en:
We have abandoned the attempts to create scent-centered media. It was a foolish idea and has brought nothing but wasted time and unpleasant odors.

In order to find our way back again we will need donations from our trusted patrons. We thank you for your continued support!

label.zh: 我们现在担负不起这个价格。
label.en: We cannot afford to donate now.

label.zh: 我们希望取消简讯订阅。
label.en: We wish to unsubscribe from this newsletter.

descriptions.zh:
你好，赞助人[Root.GetRulerName]！我们构想出了一种华丽的新型建筑，专门用来促进人们之间的互相理解——§Y文化中心§!。它的功能得益于融合了大众对彼此的潜意识偏见和艺术的偏好，然后粉碎了这些并以一种新的统一形式呈现出来。

你们想不想购买这个建筑？这一定会对你们帝国的紧密连接起到作用。如果要我自己来说的话，这可是优惠价！
descriptions.en:
Greetings, patron [Root.GetRulerName]! We have come up with a gorgeous new type of architecture, specifically tuned to improve crowds' understanding of one another - a §YMinistry of Culture§!. It functions thanks to a mix of using the populace's subconscious bias against each other and art, then smashing it all and presenting a new form of unity.

Would you like to purchase this building? It will surely prove useful to binding your empire together. And it's a bargain, if I may say so myself!

descriptions.zh: 我们十分抱歉，来自[Root.GetRulerName]的赞助人：我们很不幸陷入了创作的瓶颈期。整个城邦目前还处于紊乱的状态，尚不能提供任何成果。一如既往，我们仍然十分感谢您的赞助。
descriptions.en: We apologize, patron [Root.GetRulerName]: we have sadly reached something of a creative roadblock. The enclave is in disarray and we have nothing to offer at this time. We thank you for your patronage, as always.

descriptions.zh: 您好，来自[Root.GetRulerName]的赞助人。由于一个重大故障，我们最近不得不报废掉大多数的技术设备。您是否能用得上其中所产生的零件或原料呢？
descriptions.en: Greetings, patron [Root.GetRulerName]. We have recently been forced to scrap most of our technical equipment due to a major malfunction. Would the materials and scrap be of any use to you, by any chance?

descriptions.zh: 赞助者，我们听到这个消息真是出离地抱歉！没有时事通讯，我们就无法向你传达我们最近的成果……
descriptions.en: We are exceptionally sorry to hear that, o patron! Without the newsletter we won't be able to keep you up-to-date on our latest accomplishments...

descriptions.zh: 举办这等规模的星球盛典，那需要我们所有的艺术家都使出浑身解数。不是一件容易的工作。
descriptions.en: Organizing a festival of that scale would require all of our artists to bring their talent to bear. Not an easy job, nor a cheap one.

descriptions.zh: 很好！我们很乐意为你举办这伟大的星球盛典！
descriptions.en: Excellent! We will be delighted to create this magnificent Festival of Worlds!

descriptions.zh:
艺术家联盟主办的§Y星球盛典§!，曾经一度，给[Root.GetName]的人们带去了欢乐。哎呀，这样的事情注定不会长久。

在[this_planet.GetName]上，节日活动引发了人群的大规模踩踏事件，致使数千名公民死亡。目前尚不清楚究竟是怎样的情况导致了这一出家破人亡的餐具，但是人民对于我们的政府和盛典主办方的怨恨与日俱增。
descriptions.en:
The §YFestival of Worlds§! organized by the Artisan Troupe had, for a time, brought joy to the people of the [Root.GetName]. Alas, it was not meant to last.

On [this_planet.GetName], festival activities have resulted in a huge crowd stampeding and killing thousands of citizens. It is not clear what circumstances led to this tragic loss of life, but there is now growing resentment towards our administration and the festival's organizers alike.

options.script:
name = leviathans.335.b
add_resource = { influence = -100 }

descriptions.zh: 由于§Y星球盛典§!所带来的浓厚的快乐氛围，一些盛典的举办者们爱上了我们的生活方式。他们声称希望节日过后能够留下来；在此定居，成为我们帝国的一员。
descriptions.en: Due to the overabundance of happiness being spread by the §YFestival of Worlds§!, some of the event's organizers have begun to fall in love with our way of life. They claim they wish to remain here; to settle down and become a part of our empire.

options.script: name = leviathans.336.b

descriptions.zh:
§Y星球盛典§!突然停止了。艺术家联盟已经收拾好行李离开了，一句解释都没有。

我们彻底搜索他们的营地和演出舞台后发现，大量存放的资源已经消失。
descriptions.en:
The §YFestival of Worlds§! has abruptly stopped. The Artisan Troupe has packed their bags and left, without saying a word about why.

Thorough searches of their campsites and arenas have revealed only that a substantial quantity of resources has disappeared.

tooltips.en: The Artisan Troupe will refuse any communique for 10 years.

tooltips.zh: 原谅艺术家联盟的违约行为。
tooltips.en: The Artisan Troupe are forgiven for their transgressions.

tooltips.zh: 艺术家联盟在10年内拒收任何通讯。

descriptions.zh: 太巧了！我们正打算提出和你说的基本类似的提议！如果你将此设施建设在与我们共享星系的[GetStarbaseOrWayStation]里，我们将派遣我们最优秀的艺术家前去当教师。
descriptions.en: Brilliant! We were just about to suggest the very same thing to you! If you establish this institution on the [GetStarbaseOrWayStation] in the system you share with us, we shall send some of our finest artists to serve there as teachers.

tooltips.zh: 我们现在可以在§Y[artist_system.GetName]§!星系建造§H艺术学院§!这一[GetStarbaseOrWayStation]建筑了。
tooltips.en: We can now build the §HArt College§! [GetStarbaseOrWayStation] Building in the §Y[artist_system.GetName]§! system.

tooltips.zh: 我们现在可以在§Y[artist_system.GetName]§!星系建造§H艺术学院§!驿站模块了。
tooltips.en: We can now build the §HArt College§! Waystation Module in the §Y[artist_system.GetName]§! system.

descriptions.zh: 啊，§Y文化中心§!……它的任务就是挑战与常理背道而驰的观念，提升你帝国内艺术的凝聚力。让我来说，完全就是一个杰作。
descriptions.en: Ah, the §YMinistry of Culture§!... It was designed to challenge divergent ideas and promote greater unity throughout your empire through the medium of art. A true masterpiece, if I may say so myself.

descriptions.zh: 我们从艺术家联盟收到了一条信息。他们的一座空间站被摧毁了！
descriptions.en: We have received a transmission from the Artisan Troupe. One of their stations has been destroyed!

descriptions.zh: 我们收到了一条来自艺术家联盟首席的绝望的求救信息。他们的最后一个空间站与他们的文化都被毁灭殆尽。几乎没有幸存者留下来，艺术家联盟已经不复存在了。
descriptions.en: We received a distress signal from the headmaster of the Artisan Troupe. Their last station and cultural haven has been destroyed. There were few survivors, and the troupe is essentially no more.

descriptions.zh: 在摧毁艺术家联盟的空间站后，我们发现残骸中有大量可供回收的资源。舱室中储存的捐赠物、礼品与作品现在漂浮在太空之中，可供我们随意回收取用。
descriptions.en: After having destroyed the Artisan Troupe's station we found many resources to salvage from the wreckage. Donations, gifts and creations stacked in its halls now drift in space, ready for the taking.

descriptions.zh: 在摧毁了那个漂浮在[station_system.GetName]星系的空间站之后，我们在遗骸中发现了大量的珍贵资源。
descriptions.en: After destroying the station facility floating in the [station_system.GetName] system, we have found plenty of valuable resources amongst its remains.

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh:
您好，星际旅行者，我们是策展人。

我们遵从的古训自万古之前便由星系中的支配力量所制定。我们献身于保存世间所有的知识，来避免星系再次陷入荒蛮与死寂的黑暗时期。

但我们失败了。

我们只留下了很少的幸存者，但相比我们的前辈，我们完成自己神圣使命的决心丝毫没有动摇。我们有意与你分享一些我们的知识……当然，这不是无偿的。
descriptions.en:
Greetings, star travelers. We are the Curators.

Our ancient order was established eons ago by the various galactic powers in ascendancy at the time. We were dedicated towards the preservation of all knowledge, in an effort to safeguard the galaxy from descending into yet another dark age of mass extinctions and barbarism.

We failed.

Few of us remain today, but we are no less committed to our sacred mission than our predecessors were. We are willing to share some of our knowledge with you... for a price.

descriptions.zh: 幸会，宇宙中的探险家。与你进行通话的是[curator_enclave_country.GetName]。也许你已经知晓我们古训中的信条。和其他城邦中的策展人同行们一样，只要你们能满足我们的要求，我们便愿意同你们交易。
descriptions.en: Well met, explorers. You are speaking to the [curator_enclave_country.GetName]. Perhaps you are already familiar with the tenets of our ancient order. Like our esteemed colleagues in the other Curator enclaves, we are willing to trade provided that you can meet our rates.
descriptions.condition: trigger = { has_country_flag = curator_intro }

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh: 也许你正在疑惑我身后壁画上图案的意义。这是个好问题，答案也会十分有趣。只需要1.5亿亿能量币你便可以得到这个问题的解答。
descriptions.en: Perhaps you are wondering about the significance of the shapes you see on the mural behind me. That is a good question with a very interesting answer! The fee for this information is 15 quadrillion energy credits.

descriptions.zh: 我们是策展人，欢迎你们，请问你们需要什么服务？
descriptions.en: You have reached the Curators. How may we assist you?

descriptions.zh: 你们知不知道这次对话正在被七个来自不同领域的亚空间实体所密切地监听着？唉，想和他们交流是不可能的，因为你们的文明远不具备能与他们交流的通讯技术。
descriptions.en: Did you know that this conversation is being closely monitored by entities from seven different subspace realms? Alas, I fear that the technology to communicate with them is too far beyond the present capabilities of your civilization to do you any good.

descriptions.zh: 不用担心，我们已经更新了档案系统，[Root.GetName]的信息已经被记入了档案以供后辈们查阅。即使在你的帝国经历不可避免的消亡后，你们仍将在档案中被铭记。
descriptions.en: Fear not. We have updated our archives with information about the [Root.GetName] for future generations. You will be remembered long after the inevitable collapse of your star nation.

descriptions.zh: 我想告诉你的东西有很多，但我不能白白免费地告诉你。这个空间站需要很多能源来维持运转…我们必须考虑收支的平衡。
descriptions.en: There is so much I wish I could tell you, but I simply can't do it for free. This space station requires a lot of energy to operate... we must consider our overhead.

descriptions.zh: 谨代表策展人协会向您问候，请问您有什么需要的吗？
descriptions.en: Greetings on behalf of the Curator order. Was there something you wanted?

descriptions.zh: 我们一向很高兴能和你们的政府进行贸易，我们这里还有一些科技资源，你们有兴趣吗？
descriptions.en: As always, it is a pleasure doing business with your government. Can we interest you in some technology?

descriptions.zh: 很高兴见到你。我很肯定今天我们可以达成一些互利互惠的协定。
descriptions.en: It is good to see you. I am sure we can come to some sort of mutually beneficial agreement before this day is over.

descriptions.zh: 知识一旦落入了恶毒之徒的手中，就会变得相当危险。但我们能怎么办呢？毕竟我们需要能源才能运营下去……
descriptions.en: Knowledge in the wrong gripping appendages can be dangerous, but what can we do? We need energy to keep the lights on...

descriptions.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesName]，你们不知道的事情还有很多。求求你……让我们教授你们更多有关这个宇宙的知识吧。
descriptions.en: There is much that you do not yet know, [Root.GetSpeciesName]. Please... let us educate you about the universe.

descriptions.zh: 我们持有整个星系的详细星图，这是从上百种不同的物种处收集来的信息的汇总。也许这能提起你们的兴趣？
descriptions.en: We possess detailed star charts of the entire galaxy, gathered by explorers from a hundred different races. Perhaps they would be of interest to you?

descriptions.zh: 知识就是一切，它们必须被守护。
descriptions.en: Knowledge is everything. It must be preserved.

嗯对，这种色彩斑斓的机器出现于远古时代。我们对它的研究可以追溯到我们城邦建立之初。在我们之前已经有许多文明也对它进行了研究。

descriptions.zh: 那个颇为神经质的自动化机械体来到这个星系的时间并不长，但不要被这种新奇所迷惑。奥普斯哨兵的创造者们在被一台专横的机器同化之前，就已经是他们所在领域中最杰出的工程师之一。我们不知道自那时起，那个机器意识遭遇了怎样严酷的命运，但从哨兵那痛苦的扭动来看：情况似乎相当不稳定。如果你决定满足自己的好奇心，务必小心行事。
descriptions.en: That rather twitchy automaton is a relative newcomer to the galaxy, but don't be fooled by such novelty. The Opus Sentinel's creators were counted among the finest engineers in their sector even before they were assimilated by a tyrannical machine. We do not know what harsh fate has befallen the machine consciousness since then, but if the Sentinel's agonized writhing is anything to go by: the whole situation appears quite volatile. Tread carefully, should you decide to slake your curiosity.

descriptions.zh:
恕我冒昧，但我以为您会比我们更了解此事！与我们所研究的对象相比，那个颇为不安的自动化机械体是个新面孔，但作为对手同样令人畏惧。

我们知道，即便在被同化之前，奥普斯哨兵背后的工程师们也被认为是该领域最优秀的人才。因此，那艘战舰不容小觑。我们不太清楚的是，这艘船是如何与[origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetName]如此疏远的。从“哨兵”痛苦的扭动来看，我们推测情况仍然相当不稳定。您是否同意这一评估，[root.GetSpeciesName]？
descriptions.en:
Forgive my impertinence, but I assumed you would know more about it than we do! That rather twitchy automaton is a newcomer compared to what we usually study here, but is no less fearsome an opponent.

We know that even before they were assimilated, the engineers behind the Opus Sentinel were counted among the finest in their sector. That warship is therefore not to be underestimated. What is less clear to us is how the vessel became so detached from the [origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetName]. We gather from the Sentinel's agonized writhing that the whole situation remains quite volatile. Would you agree with assessment, [root.GetSpeciesName]?

descriptions.zh: 在[curator_system.GetName]星系摧毁了策展人的空间站之后，我们能干的军队在策展人曾经占据的区域搜寻任何有价值的东西。他们成功恢复了一下策展人数据库的内存碎片，这将能极大地促进我们的研究。
descriptions.en: After destroying the ancient Curator station in the [curator_system.GetName] system, our capable forces combed the area it once occupied for anything valuable. They managed to recover several memory fragments from the Curator databanks that should be a great boon to our research.

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh:
深空通讯阵列获取了从[curator_system.GetName]星系的策展人城邦发来的简短的自动悲报。通讯在几分钟之后停止，长距探测器确认了远古空间站被摧毁。

残余离子轨迹表明，这次袭击是§Y[curator_destroyer.GetName]§!所为。
descriptions.en:
Deep space communication arrays picked up a brief automated distress call from the Curator station in the [curator_system.GetName] system. The transmission ceased after just a few minutes, and long-range recon probes have confirmed that the ancient space station has been destroyed.

Residual ion trails suggest that forces from the §Y[curator_destroyer.GetName]§! were behind this attack.

descriptions.zh:
深空通讯阵列获取了从[curator_system.GetName]星系的策展人城邦发来的简短的自动悲报。通讯在几分钟之后停止，长距探测器确认了远古空间站被摧毁。

发动此次袭击的势力尚不明确。
descriptions.en:
Deep space communication arrays picked up a brief automated distress call from the Curator station in the [curator_system.GetName] system. The transmission ceased after just a few minutes, and long-range recon probes have confirmed that the ancient space station has been destroyed.

The forces responsible for this attack remain unidentified.

descriptions.zh:
与[From.GetName]的一切联络均已中断。经过侦测，确认古老的策展人空间站已被摧毁。 这些报告表明进攻势力隶属于§Y[curator_destroyer.GetName]§!。

不幸的是，策展人势力的消弭也意味着我们再也没办法使用他们庞大的数据库了。
descriptions.en:
All contact has been lost with the [From.GetName], and our recon assets have confirmed that the ancient Curator station was destroyed. These reports suggest the attack force belonged to the §Y[curator_destroyer.GetName]§!.

Unfortunately, the demise of the Curators means we have also lost access to their extensive databanks.

label.zh: 他们的遗产真的是可惜了。
label.en: A sad end to their legacy.

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh:
看来我们真是高估你们了，你们的人根本不具备文明处事的能力。真是奇怪……我们通常在刚见面的时候就可以准确识别出某个物种是否具备好斗倾向。为什么对你们看走眼了呢。

我们已经剥夺了你们对我们数据库的访问权限。
descriptions.en:
It would appear that we grossly overestimated your capacity to act as a civilized nation. Strange... We are usually able to identify the violent ones at an early stage.

We have severed your access to our databanks, of course.

options.script: name = leviathans.156.a

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh: 你们这群笨蛋！袭击我们就等于放弃了知识，你们的后辈们将活在低科技水平的蛮荒之中！
descriptions.en: You fool! By attacking us, you are condemning future generations to lives of low-tech misery!

descriptions.zh: 你们受本能驱使而袭击我们，而现在你们要为此付出代价。我们将永远不再与[Root.GetName]分享我们的知识。
descriptions.en: Your base instincts compelled you to attack us, and now you must pay the price. We will never share our knowledge with the [Root.GetName] again.

descriptions.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，我们慷慨相助，你们却不识好人心。一群野蛮的渣滓！
descriptions.en: We had so much to offer you [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], and yet you would throw it all away. Neo-barbarian scum!

descriptions.zh: 你们已经成为整个策展人组织的敌人。
descriptions.en: You have been declared an enemy of the entire Curator Order.

descriptions.zh:
在[From.GetName]星系遇到的这种生物不同于[Root.GetName]以往遇见的任何其他生物。

它们具有极强的攻击性与攻击能力，守护着一颗初步扫描发现蕴藏有大量资源的小行星。
descriptions.en:
The creature observed in the [From.GetName] system is unlike anything the [Root.GetName] has previously encountered.

Highly aggressive and with destructive capabilities to match, it guards a planetoid that initial scans indicate is exceptionally resource-rich.

descriptions.zh:
在[From.GetName]星系观察到的生物与我们母星系的天龙粗看具有一些相似度，但进一步的扫描发现他们是截然不同的生物，并且两者的进化过程也彼此不相关。

它具有极强的攻击性与攻击能力，守护着一颗小行星，初步扫描显示其中蕴含着丰富的资源。
descriptions.en:
The creature observed in the [From.GetName] system bears some initial resemblance to the Sky Dragon of our home system, although further scans demonstrate that it is clearly a different species, and probably even evolved independently to it.

Highly aggressive and with destructive capabilities to match, it guards a planetoid that initial scans indicate is exceptionally resource-rich.

options.script: name = leviathans.610.a

descriptions.zh:
我们收到了舰队全灭前发出的最后一则信息。其中提到，这个硕大的敌人似乎盯上了舰队的超光速踪迹……

如果这种怪兽记住了我们的气味，我们最好为之后的疯狂报复做好准备。
descriptions.en:
We received one last transmission from our fleet before it was destroyed. It mentions their gigantic foe seemingly homing in on the fleet's FTL signature...

If the beast has our scent, we should be prepared for savage retaliation.

descriptions.zh:
当以太巨龙攻击我们舰船的时候，它似乎可以追踪到我们飞船的超光速特征信号……

如果该生物记住了我们的气味，我们最好为之后的疯狂报复做好准备。
descriptions.en:
As the Ether Drake was attacking our vessels, it seemed to be homing in on the fleet's FTL signature...

If the creature has our scent, we should prepare for savage retaliation.

label.zh: 全体部队进入警戒状态。

descriptions.zh:
我们收我们接收到了来自[Root.GetName]的在进行紧急跃迁之前发出的最后的信号。其中指出他们所遇到的巨大的生物能跟踪舰队的超光速踪迹……

如果让那东西记住了我们的气味，我们最好为之后的疯狂报复做好准备。
descriptions.en:
We received one last transmission from the [Root.GetName] before the fleet engaged emergency FTL protocols and went dark. It includes mention of the gargantuan creature they had been fighting seemingly homing in on the fleet's FTL signature...

If the beast has our scent, we should be prepared for savage retaliation.

descriptions.zh:
在[From.GetName]的地壳深处，埋藏着一些不完整的化石残骸，似乎是曾居住在[From.GetStarName]星系之中的以太巨龙的近亲。

这位以太巨龙的表亲死后，经过漫长的岁月，其柔软的身体组织已经硬化成石头，其骨骼也变得坚硬无比，形成了矿物一样的内部结构。
descriptions.en:
Buried deep in the crust of [From.GetName] are the partial, fossilized remains of what appears to have been a close relative to the Ether Drake that once dwelled in the [From.GetStarName] system.

In the eons since this cousin-Drake's passing, its soft tissues have ossified and its bones indurated, becoming mineral-like in structure.

grant_dragon_armor_effect = yes

descriptions.zh:
当我们围绕§Y龙之宝藏§!运行的开采站正在重新定位以对准一条资源极其丰富的矿脉时，传感器侦测到其中仍有些我们尚未发现的东西。

一个完好无损的§Y以太巨龙的蛋§!被埋在小行星的地表下，周围散落着一些运气相较不那么好的同类的被碾碎的蛋壳。蛋已经从矿坑里挖出来了，但是它未来的命运还悬而未决。
descriptions.en:
As our mining station orbiting §YDragon's Hoard§! was repositioning to align with a particularly rich mineral vein, sensors picked up something that had hitherto gone undetected.

An undamaged §YEther Drake egg§! in pristine condition, buried beneath the surface of the planetoid and surrounded by the smashed shells of several less fortunate specimens. The egg has been excavated and removed from the mining site, but its ultimate fate remains undecided.

label.zh: 如果能培育出一头小以太龙，我们就能得到强大的伙伴……
label.en: A young Ether Drake would make a formidable ally...

label.zh: 既然消灭了它，就不要留后患。
label.en: The last one was killed for a reason.

descriptions.zh: 龙蛋孵化了。
descriptions.en: The egg hatches.

tooltips.en: Young Ether Drake §HScile§! joins the fleets of the [Root.Owner.GetName].

descriptions.zh:
负责龙蛋的外星生物学家表示，从龙之宝藏小行星回收的以太巨龙的蛋已经过了孵化期限。

孵化以太龙的计划已经没有任何希望了。
descriptions.en:
The Ether Drake egg recovered from the Dragon's Hoard planetoid has, in the words of the xenobiologist in charge of the ovum, passed its expiry date.

There is no longer any hope of hatching the creature within.

descriptions.zh:
从名为龙之宝藏的小行星回收的以太巨龙的蛋已经无法孵化。

这个种群灭绝了。
descriptions.en:
The Ether Drake egg recovered from the Dragon's Hoard planetoid can no longer be considered viable.

The species is extinct.

descriptions.zh: 以太巨龙的蛋中止了。生物进程已崩溃，且无可用的错误报告用于调试。
descriptions.en: The Ether Drake egg is terminated. Biological processes have crashed, and there are no available error reports for debugging.

descriptions.zh:
可怕的以太巨龙已经被击杀。英勇无畏的指挥官[From.From.GetLeaderName]和[From.From.GetName]将流芳百世。

之前那头巨兽千方百计守护的那颗§H小行星§!现在可以放心开采了。谁知道它千百亿年以来积累了怎样的宝藏？
descriptions.en:
The formidable Ether Drake has been slain. The exceptional bravery of Commander [From.From.GetLeaderName] and the [From.From.GetName] will not soon be forgotten.

The §Hplanetoid§! the beast guarded so jealously can now be safely exploited. Who knows what treasures the creature might have amassed over the eons?

descriptions.en:

label.zh: 让我们看看它的遗骸还藏了什么秘密。
label.en: Let's see what secrets its remains may yield.

tooltips.zh: 解锁用于§Y星神兽转基因§!的§Y龙鳞化§!特质。

descriptions.zh: 在忙碌了好一阵子后，我们的死灵法师让§Y以太巨龙§!再次充满了能量。意识融合的结果颇有些摇晃不稳，但我们觉得这还是很成功的，毕竟这个生物的超高温吐息仍可以正常运转。
descriptions.en: After much work, our necromancers have once more filled the §YEther Drake§! with energy. The resulting fusion of consciousness is lurching and unnerving, but we will call this a success as long as the creature's superheated breath still functions.

descriptions.zh:
§Y以太巨龙§!的躯体似乎坚不可摧。放弃对劫持其中枢神经并从中控制的尝试后，我们被迫用仿生[root.GetIndividualName]逐一替换它的神经。

让我们看看能不能让这具躯壳再发出吼声吧。
descriptions.en:
The §YEther Drake's§! biology appeared at first to be impenetrable. Instead of hijacking its central nervous system and assuming control from there, we were forced to replace every one of its nerves with a [root.GetIndividualName] facsimile.

Let's see if we can make the husk roar.

descriptions.zh:
据计算§Y以太巨龙§!尸体的年代远于922337203685477580-

§R错误：超出注册大小。§!

由于我们已经用最具实验性的反应堆取代了它的内部结构，进一步的研究将变得更加容易。
descriptions.en:
Calculations of the §YEther Drake§! carcass dated it to be older than 922337203685477580-

§RERROR: EXCEEDED SIZE OF REGISTRY.§!

Further study will be more accessible now that we have replaced its internal structure with our most experimental reactors.
